title: A durable spawn's hibernation ref
description: the wake ref, as JSON text of at most 512 characters without control characters or credentials, that swarm spawn --durable gives the broker and the spawn waker reads back from the wake request

argv.description: the resumed run's words before its prompt; the program's basename is the harness

idle_s.description: seconds the held worker waits for a message, above 0; null for no limit

parent.description: the address the worker sits under
